grounding.derivation: The prefix test independently specifies that earlier released statuses retain their own ctx/from. Peer.ReadIndex accepts the supplied SystemCtx as request identity, and the public interface promises an outcome for the returned request. The actual requester consumes readiness by exact SystemCtx; no index-only association or prefix-completion API exists there. Consequently remote publication of a released status must carry that status identity to its requester. This is a local correlation duty, not an inference that every admitted read must succeed before its timeout. The release handler is implementation evidence and the suspected deviation, not normative authority by itself.
grounding.applicability: Only confirmed prefix members in the same leader readIndex lifetime are covered. Transport loss before confirmation does not excuse misidentification after the implementation elects to release a request.
